data.fund_name: Franklin India Ultra Short Duration Fund
data.fund_type: An open ended ultra short debt scheme investing in instruments such that the Macaulay duration of the portfolio is between 3months to 6 months.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to provide a combination of regular income and high liquidity by investing primarilyin a mix of short term debt and money market instruments. However, there is no assurance that the investment objective ofthe Scheme will be achieved
data.asset_allocation: Under normal circumstances, the investment range would be as follows: Debt securities*, and Money Market Instruments,cash & cash equivalent: 0% - 100% *including central and state Government Securities upto 100%, Securitised Debt up to 50%
data.benchmark: NIFTY Ultra Short Duration Debt Index A-I
